name: io.github.rezasoleymanifar/vintage
title: Vintage
description: A research terminal that costs $0 and won't lie to you about your Sharpe. Point-in-time financial data from SEC EDGAR, FRED and Ken French behind six verbs, with a backtester that deflates your Sharpe by how many specs you tried.

environmentVariables.name: VINTAGE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Contact string sent to SEC EDGAR, which asks for a real name and email. Format: 'Your Name your@email.com'.

environmentVariables.name: FRED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free key from https://fredaccount.stlouisfed.org/apikeys. Unlocks 800k macro series with ALFRED first-release vintages. Everything else works without it.

environmentVariables.name: VINTAGE_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the gzipped response cache lives. Defaults to ~/.cache/vintage.
